description: Source code for a utility that fixes MD5 headers in WRG formatted images on MTD devices, including functions for reading, writing, and verifying headers, as well as handling endianness.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRG header of a device image.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header in an MTD device at a specified offset.
